Architecture rules for the newspipe RSS source scanning and validation module.

LAYER.ORDER: domain > application > infrastructure > control. Dependencies point inward only. New domain models live in domain/models; ports and the scan orchestration live in application; HTTP, Rome parsing, manifest and result adapters live in infrastructure; wiring and Main live in control.

ARCH.HEX: application/ports/Ports.scala owns every boundary. Application services depend on traits, never on adapters. The existing RssSource port remains the collection boundary: validated feeds reach IngestionService through a new RssSource implementation, not through a new pipeline.

ARCH.DI: every adapter instance is constructed in control/dependencyInjection/AppContainer.scala. No service locator, no global mutable singleton, no companion-object state.

ARCH.DIP: high-level SourceScanService defines the work; infrastructure adapters implement SourceManifestReader, FeedProbe, FeedValidator and ValidationResultStore.

ARCH.NO_CROSS_LAYER: domain imports no circe, Rome, HTTP, Spark or Kafka. Application imports domain plus scala/java stdlib and logging. Infrastructure imports application and domain. Control imports all layers.

ARCH.DOTENV.MERGE: every new setting resolves process environment, then discovered .env, then conf/ingestion.conf. .env is read only and never written or committed.

ARCH.NO_NEW_INFRA: no queue, database, framework, daemon, cron entry or external scheduler. Results persist as one JSON file under the pipeline's gitignored target/ directory. LLM calls stay out of ingestion; enrichment keeps its nvidia model chain and its own future batching work.

APP.LANGUAGE: Scala 3.3.4 on JDK 21 with sbt. ARCH.PYTHON.* does not apply to this feature.

ARCH.SEVERITY: CRITICAL, MAJOR, MINOR, TRIVIAL. CRITICAL and MAJOR stop the chain.

STATUS: every Coder reports COMPLETED, BLOCKED or ESCALATED with a self-assessed SEVERITY in its feedback file.

Prove: each implementation step carries the exact command and expected output that demonstrates the step landed.

Do NOT touch: pipelines/enrichment, conf/enrichment.conf, the relevance-classification code, Bronze/Silver/Gold schema, scripts/newspipe, and .env.

Stop when: all CU proves are green and no forbidden file has changed.

Legend for feat-16-scan-and-validate-rss-sources.

CU IDs: cu-001 through cu-011, executed in the wave order in waves.json.

SECTIONS: REQUIREMENTS (what the CU delivers), COORDINATES (exact DTR keys, absent key means creation), IMPLEMENTATION_STEPS (numbered, fenced, proved), ACCEPTANCE (spec test IDs with commands and expected results).

STATUS values: COMPLETED, BLOCKED, ESCALATED. SEVERITY values: CRITICAL, MAJOR, MINOR, TRIVIAL.

ValidationStatus values: Usable, TemporarilyUnavailable, Invalid, NeedsInvestigation.

Reason codes: ok, http-<code>, probe-error, discovery-probe-error, html-autodiscovery, html-not-feed, empty-body, parse-error, not-rss-atom, empty-feed, empty-entries, missing-metadata.

Prove: a command under each step; a step without a passing Prove is not done.

Do NOT touch: an explicit per-step list; violating it is a CRITICAL finding.

Stop when: the step's Prove command has the stated output and the named next CU owns the remainder.

```scala
package newspipe.domain.models



import io.circe.Decoder

import io.circe.Encoder

import io.circe.generic.semiauto.deriveDecoder

import io.circe.generic.semiauto.deriveEncoder



enum ValidationStatus:

  case Usable, TemporarilyUnavailable, Invalid, NeedsInvestigation



final case class SourceCandidate(

    publisherId: String,

    title: Option[String],

    provenance: Option[String],

    urls: List[String]

)



final case class ProbeResponse(

    statusCode: Int,

    finalUrl: String,

    contentType: String,

    body: String

)



final case class FeedValidation(

    url: String,

    status: ValidationStatus,

    reason: String,

    checkedAtMillis: Long,

    detail: String,

    feedType: Option[String],

    entryCount: Int,

    hasDates: Boolean,

    hasIds: Boolean

)



final case class CandidateReport(candidate: SourceCandidate, validations: List[FeedValidation])



final case class ValidationSnapshot(

    version: Int,

    generatedAtMillis: Long,

    reports: List[CandidateReport]

)



object SourceValidationModels:

  given Encoder[ValidationStatus] = Encoder.encodeString.contramap(_.toString)

  given Decoder[ValidationStatus] = Decoder.decodeString.emap { value =>

    ValidationStatus.values.find(_.toString == value).toRight("unknown validation status: " + value)

  }

  given Encoder[SourceCandidate] = deriveEncoder

  given Decoder[SourceCandidate] = deriveDecoder

  given Encoder[FeedValidation] = deriveEncoder

  given Decoder[FeedValidation] = deriveDecoder

  given Encoder[CandidateReport] = deriveEncoder

  given Decoder[CandidateReport] = deriveDecoder

  given Encoder[ValidationSnapshot] = deriveEncoder

  given Decoder[ValidationSnapshot] = deriveDecoder

```

```scala
import io.circe.parser.parse

import newspipe.application.ports.SourceManifestReader

import newspipe.domain.models.SourceCandidate

import java.nio.file.Files

final class JsonSourceManifestReader extends SourceManifestReader:

    if !Files.isRegularFile(file) then Left("manifest not found: " + path)
```

1. In `pipelines/ingestion/src/main/scala/newspipe/infrastructure/source/JavaHttpFeedProbe.scala`, create this file. `computeIfAbsent` makes repeated URLs share one probe result within one service instance; `Try` converts connection and timeout failures into Left.



```scala

package newspipe.infrastructure.source



import newspipe.application.ports.FeedProbe

import newspipe.domain.models.ProbeResponse



import java.net.URI

import java.net.http.HttpClient

import java.net.http.HttpRequest

import java.net.http.HttpResponse

import java.time.Duration

import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap

import scala.util.Try



final class JavaHttpFeedProbe(timeout: Duration = Duration.ofSeconds(10)) extends FeedProbe:

  private val http: HttpClient = HttpClient.newBuilder()

    .connectTimeout(timeout)

    .followRedirects(HttpClient.Redirect.NORMAL)

    .build()

  private val cache: ConcurrentHashMap[String, Either[String, ProbeResponse]] = ConcurrentHashMap[String, Either[String, ProbeResponse]]()



  def probe(url: String): Either[String, ProbeResponse] =

    cache.computeIfAbsent(url, _ => fetch(url))



  private def fetch(url: String): Either[String, ProbeResponse] =

    Try {

      val request: HttpRequest = HttpRequest.newBuilder(URI.create(url))

        .timeout(timeout)

        .header("User-Agent", "newspipe-scala/0.2")

        .GET()

        .build()

      val response: HttpResponse[String] = http.send(request, HttpResponse.BodyHandlers.ofString())

      ProbeResponse(

        statusCode = response.statusCode(),

        finalUrl = response.uri().toString,

        contentType = response.headers().firstValue("content-type").orElse(""),

        body = response.body()

      )

    }.toEither.left.map(error => "probe failed for " + url + ": " + error.getMessage)

```

1. In `pipelines/ingestion/src/main/scala/newspipe/infrastructure/source/RomeFeedValidator.scala`, create this file. It parses RSS/Atom through SyndFeedInput, treats HTML with an alternate RSS/Atom link as a discovery case, and never calls an LLM.



```scala

package newspipe.infrastructure.source



import com.rometools.rome.io.SyndFeedInput

import com.rometools.rome.io.XmlReader

import newspipe.application.ports.FeedValidator

import newspipe.domain.models.FeedValidation

import newspipe.domain.models.ProbeResponse

import newspipe.domain.models.SourceCandidate

import newspipe.domain.models.ValidationStatus



import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream

import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets

import java.util.regex.Matcher

import java.util.regex.Pattern

import scala.jdk.CollectionConverters.*

import scala.util.Try



final class RomeFeedValidator extends FeedValidator:

  private val LinkTag: Pattern = Pattern.compile("<link\\b[^>]*>", Pattern.CASE_INSENSITIVE)

  private val HrefAttr: Pattern = Pattern.compile("href\\s*=\\s*[\"']([^\"']+)[\"']", Pattern.CASE_INSENSITIVE)

  private val RelAttr: Pattern = Pattern.compile("rel\\s*=\\s*[\"']([^\"']+)[\"']", Pattern.CASE_INSENSITIVE)

  private val TypeAttr: Pattern = Pattern.compile("type\\s*=\\s*[\"']([^\"']+)[\"']", Pattern.CASE_INSENSITIVE)

  private val FeedTypes: Set[String] = Set("application/rss+xml", "application/atom+xml", "application/xml")



  def discover(body: String): Option[String] =

    val matcher: Matcher = LinkTag.matcher(body)

    var found: Option[String] = None

    while matcher.find() && found.isEmpty do

      val tag: String = matcher.group()

      val rel: Option[String] = attribute(RelAttr, tag)

      val kind: Option[String] = attribute(TypeAttr, tag)

      if rel.exists(_.toLowerCase.contains("alternate")) && kind.exists(k => FeedTypes.contains(k.toLowerCase)) then

        found = attribute(HrefAttr, tag)

    found



  def validate(candidate: SourceCandidate, response: ProbeResponse, nowMillis: Long): FeedValidation =

    if response.statusCode != 200 then

      val status: ValidationStatus =

        if response.statusCode == 429 || response.statusCode >= 500 then ValidationStatus.TemporarilyUnavailable

        else ValidationStatus.Invalid

      record(response.finalUrl, status, "http-" + response.statusCode, nowMillis,

        "publisher=" + candidate.publisherId + " content-type=" + response.contentType, None, 0, false, false)

    else if response.body.isBlank then

      record(response.finalUrl, ValidationStatus.Invalid, "empty-body", nowMillis,

        "publisher=" + candidate.publisherId, None, 0, false, false)

    else if isHtml(response.body) then

      discover(response.body) match

        case Some(link) => record(link, ValidationStatus.NeedsInvestigation, "html-autodiscovery", nowMillis,

          "publisher=" + candidate.publisherId + " discovered=" + link, None, 0, false, false)

        case None => record(response.finalUrl, ValidationStatus.Invalid, "html-not-feed", nowMillis,

          "publisher=" + candidate.publisherId, None, 0, false, false)

    else

      parse(response.body) match

        case Left(error) => record(response.finalUrl, ValidationStatus.Invalid, "parse-error", nowMillis,

          "publisher=" + candidate.publisherId + " " + error, None, 0, false, false)

        case Right(feed) =>

          val feedType: String = feed.getFeedType

          val lower: String = feedType.toLowerCase

          if !lower.contains("rss") && !lower.contains("atom") then

            record(response.finalUrl, ValidationStatus.Invalid, "not-rss-atom", nowMillis,

              "publisher=" + candidate.publisherId + " feedType=" + feedType, Some(feedType), 0, false, false)

          else

            val entries: List[com.rometools.rome.feed.synd.SyndEntry] = feed.getEntries.asScala.toList

            val dates: Boolean = entries.exists(e => e.getPublishedDate != null)

            val ids: Boolean = entries.exists(e => e.getUri != null && e.getUri.nonEmpty)

            val meaningful: Boolean = entries.exists(e =>

              Option(e.getTitle).exists(_.nonEmpty) ||

                Option(e.getDescription).map(_.getValue).exists(_.nonEmpty)

            )

            val rdf: Boolean = lower.contains("rss_1.0") || response.body.contains("<rdf:RDF")

            if entries.isEmpty then

              record(response.finalUrl, ValidationStatus.Invalid, "empty-feed", nowMillis,

                "publisher=" + candidate.publisherId + " feedType=" + feedType, Some(feedType), 0, dates, ids)

            else if rdf then

              record(response.finalUrl, ValidationStatus.NeedsInvestigation, "rss-1.0-needs-module", nowMillis,

                "publisher=" + candidate.publisherId + " feedType=" + feedType, Some(feedType), entries.size, dates, ids)

            else if !meaningful then

              record(response.finalUrl, ValidationStatus.Invalid, "empty-entries", nowMillis,

                "publisher=" + candidate.publisherId + " feedType=" + feedType, Some(feedType), entries.size, dates, ids)

            else if !dates || !ids then

              record(response.finalUrl, ValidationStatus.NeedsInvestigation, "missing-metadata", nowMillis,

                "publisher=" + candidate.publisherId + " feedType=" + feedType, Some(feedType), entries.size, dates, ids)

            else

              record(response.finalUrl, ValidationStatus.Usable, "ok", nowMillis,

                "publisher=" + candidate.publisherId + " feedType=" + feedType, Some(feedType), entries.size, true, true)



  private def parse(body: String): Either[String, com.rometools.rome.feed.synd.SyndFeed] =

    Try {

      val stream: ByteArrayInputStream = new ByteArrayInputStream(body.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8))

      new SyndFeedInput().build(new XmlReader(stream))

    }.toEither.left.map(error => "Rome parse failed: " + error.getMessage)



  private def attribute(pattern: Pattern, tag: String): Option[String] =

    val matcher: Matcher = pattern.matcher(tag)

    if matcher.find() then Option(matcher.group(1)).filter(_.nonEmpty) else None



  private def isHtml(body: String): Boolean =

    val lower: String = body.trim.toLowerCase

    lower.startsWith("<!doctype html") || lower.startsWith("<html")



  private def record(url: String, status: ValidationStatus, reason: String, nowMillis: Long,

      detail: String, feedType: Option[String], entryCount: Int, hasDates: Boolean, hasIds: Boolean): FeedValidation =

    FeedValidation(url, status, reason, nowMillis, detail, feedType, entryCount, hasDates, hasIds)

```

```scala
package newspipe.infrastructure.source



import io.circe.parser.decode

import io.circe.syntax.*

import newspipe.application.ports.ValidationResultStore

import newspipe.domain.models.SourceValidationModels.given

import newspipe.domain.models.ValidationSnapshot



import java.nio.file.Files

import java.nio.file.Path

import java.nio.file.StandardCopyOption

import scala.util.Try



final class JsonValidationResultStore(path: String) extends ValidationResultStore:

  def load(): Either[String, Option[ValidationSnapshot]] =

    val file: Path = Path.of(path)

    if !Files.isRegularFile(file) then Right(None)

    else

      decode[ValidationSnapshot](Files.readString(file)) match

        case Right(snapshot) => Right(Some(snapshot))

        case Left(error) => Left("validation results " + path + ": " + error.getMessage)



  def save(snapshot: ValidationSnapshot): Either[String, Unit] =

    Try {

      val file: Path = Path.of(path)

      val parent: Path = file.getParent

      if parent != null then Files.createDirectories(parent)

      val temporary: Path = Path.of(path + ".tmp")

      Files.writeString(temporary, snapshot.asJson.noSpaces)

      Files.move(temporary, file, StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING)

      ()

    }.toEither.left.map(error => "save validation results " + path + ": " + error.getMessage)

```

```scala

package newspipe.application.services



import com.typesafe.scalalogging.LazyLogging

import newspipe.application.ports.FeedProbe

import newspipe.application.ports.FeedValidator

import newspipe.application.ports.SourceManifestReader

import newspipe.application.ports.ValidationResultStore

import newspipe.domain.models.CandidateReport

import newspipe.domain.models.FeedValidation

import newspipe.domain.models.SourceCandidate

import newspipe.domain.models.ValidationSnapshot

import newspipe.domain.models.ValidationStatus



import java.time.Instant

import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService

import java.util.concurrent.Executors

import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit

import scala.concurrent.Await

import scala.concurrent.ExecutionContext

import scala.concurrent.Future

import scala.concurrent.duration.Duration



final case class ScanReport(

    usableUrls: List[String],

    candidates: Int,

    usable: Int,

    unavailable: Int,

    invalid: Int,

    investigation: Int

)



final class SourceScanService(

    reader: SourceManifestReader,

    probe: FeedProbe,

    validator: FeedValidator,

    store: ValidationResultStore,

    manifestPath: String,

    workers: Int,

    reprobe: Boolean

) extends LazyLogging:

  private val pool: ExecutorService = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(math.max(1, workers))

  private given ExecutionContext = ExecutionContext.fromExecutorService(pool)



  def close(): Unit =

    pool.shutdown()

    pool.awaitTermination(30, TimeUnit.SECONDS)

    ()



  def runOnce(): Either[String, ScanReport] =

    reader.read(manifestPath).flatMap { candidates =>

      val prior: Map[String, List[FeedValidation]] = store.load() match

        case Right(Some(snapshot)) => snapshot.reports.map(report => report.candidate.publisherId -> report.validations).toMap

        case _ => Map.empty[String, List[FeedValidation]]

      val now: Long = Instant.now().toEpochMilli

      val futures: List[Future[CandidateReport]] = candidates.map(candidate => Future(scanCandidate(candidate, prior, now)))

      val reports: List[CandidateReport] = Await.result(Future.sequence(futures), Duration.Inf)

      val snapshot: ValidationSnapshot = ValidationSnapshot(1, now, reports)

      store.save(snapshot).map { _ =>

        val all: List[FeedValidation] = reports.flatMap(_.validations)

        ScanReport(

          usableUrls = all.filter(_.status == ValidationStatus.Usable).map(_.url).distinct,

          candidates = reports.size,

          usable = all.count(_.status == ValidationStatus.Usable),

          unavailable = all.count(_.status == ValidationStatus.TemporarilyUnavailable),

          invalid = all.count(_.status == ValidationStatus.Invalid),

          investigation = all.count(_.status == ValidationStatus.NeedsInvestigation)

        )

      }

    }



  private def scanCandidate(candidate: SourceCandidate, prior: Map[String, List[FeedValidation]], now: Long): CandidateReport =

    prior.get(candidate.publisherId) match

      case Some(existing) if !reprobe && existing.exists(_.status == ValidationStatus.Usable) =>

        CandidateReport(candidate, existing)

      case _ =>

        val validations: List[FeedValidation] = candidate.urls.flatMap { url =>

          probe.probe(url) match

            case Left(error) => List(FeedValidation(url, ValidationStatus.TemporarilyUnavailable,

              "probe-error", now, error, None, 0, false, false))

            case Right(response) =>

              val first: FeedValidation = validator.validate(candidate, response, now)

              if first.reason == "html-autodiscovery" then

                probe.probe(first.url) match

                  case Left(error) => List(FeedValidation(first.url, ValidationStatus.TemporarilyUnavailable,

                    "discovery-probe-error", now, error, None, 0, false, false))

                  case Right(discovered) => List(validator.validate(candidate, discovered, now))

              else List(first)

        }

        CandidateReport(candidate, validations)
```

```scala
    val calls: AtomicInteger = new AtomicInteger(0)

    server.createContext("/", exchange => {

      calls.incrementAndGet()

      val result: (Int, String, String) = handler(exchange.getRequestURI.toString, exchange.getRequestHeaders.getFirst("User-Agent"))

      exchange.getResponseHeaders.add("Content-Type", result._2)

      val bytes: Array[Byte] = result._3.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8)

      exchange.sendResponseHeaders(result._1, bytes.length.toLong)

      exchange.getResponseBody.write(bytes)

      exchange.close()

    })

    server.start()

    try test(server.getAddress.getPort)

    finally server.stop(0)



  test("probe captures status, redirect target and content type") {

      if path == "/start" then (302, "text/plain", "")

      assert(ok.isRight)

      assert(ok.toOption.get.statusCode == 200)

      assert(ok.toOption.get.contentType == "text/plain")

      val error: Either[String, ProbeResponse] = probe.probe("http://127.0.0.1:" + port + "/gone")

      assert(error.toOption.get.statusCode == 404)

    }

      val url: String = "http://127.0.0.1:" + port + "/rss"

    }

    assert(probe.probe("http://127.0.0.1:1/refused").isLeft)

  }
```

```scala
import java.time.Duration



final class SourceValidationIntegrationSpec extends AnyFunSuite:

  private val rss: String = "<?xml version=\"1.0\"?><rss version=\"2.0\"><channel><title>T</title><link>http://f</link><description>D</description><item><title>I</title><link>http://f/1</link><guid>http://f/1</guid><description>Body</description><pubDate>Tue, 26 Nov 2024 10:00:00 GMT</pubDate></item></channel></rss>"



  private final class SingleReader(url: String) extends SourceManifestReader:

    def read(path: String): Either[String, List[SourceCandidate]] =

      Right(List(SourceCandidate("pub", None, None, List(url))))



  private final class DirectProbe extends FeedProbe:

    def probe(url: String): Either[String, ProbeResponse] =

      Right(ProbeResponse(200, url, "application/rss+xml", rss))



  private final class MemoryStore extends ValidationResultStore:

    private var snapshot: Option[ValidationSnapshot] = None

      snapshot = Some(value)

      Right(())



  test("scan result flows into the collection adapter and yields one item") {

    val server: HttpServer = HttpServer.create(new InetSocketAddress("127.0.0.1", 0), 0)

    server.createContext("/rss", exchange => {

      val bytes: Array[Byte] = rss.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8)

      exchange.getResponseHeaders.add("Content-Type", "application/rss+xml")

      exchange.sendResponseHeaders(200, bytes.length.toLong)

      exchange.getResponseBody.write(bytes)

      exchange.close()

    server.start()

    val source: ValidatedRssSource = new ValidatedRssSource(usableUrls, Duration.ofSeconds(2))

    assert(source.fetch().size == 1)

    service.close()

    server.stop(0)

  }
```
